correctness.rationale: Every dimension-at-least-two face has a unique Johnson star/top; an explicit decreasing free-face collapse gives a two-dimensional complex, and the hypersimplex two-skeleton proves simply connectedness. Thus only free H2 survives. The signed alternating-chain trace gives the pure permutation formula; complement interchanges maximal-clique types and the exact invariant-edge parity-half classification proves the twisted cases. An independent face enumerator checked 60 signed character instances, and exact mod-two boundary elimination verified the first claimed dimension 181.

residual_risks: The full manuscript arxiv:2606.20784v1 was not accessible for page-by-page appendix comparison; equivalent middle-layer calculations cannot be categorically ruled out.
Other unindexed literature could present the same complement-twisted character in an equivalent representation-theoretic form.
The database and own-history searches are overlap screens, not a proof of novelty or scientific independence.

value.rationale: The natural balanced Johnson middle layer has a central complement involution that exchanges star and top facets; nonequivariant homotopy and the previously covered weight-three character lose this information. Closed formulas for every permutation and complement-twisted permutation give a complete infinite-family rational symmetry invariant, determine all rational irreducible multiplicities, and imply uniform trace -1 and unequal complement eigenspaces.
